usage: source-check.py [-h] --repo-root REPO_ROOT --record RECORD
                       --source-manifest SOURCE_MANIFEST
                       --source-projection SOURCE_PROJECTION --output OUTPUT
                       [--authority-root AUTHORITY_ROOT]
                       [--stereo-python STEREO_PYTHON]

Portable one-record source replay; implementation work, not independent
approval. All inputs are explicit. Original metadata and bytes are preserved;
only a new external receipt and its exclusively created companion directory
may be written. No network access, maintained output, or whole-corpus gate is
performed.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --record RECORD
  --source-manifest SOURCE_MANIFEST
  --source-projection SOURCE_PROJECTION
  --output OUTPUT
  --authority-root AUTHORITY_ROOT
                        Optional prepared authority root; policy must match
                        repo-root exactly
  --stereo-python STEREO_PYTHON
                        Explicit Python interpreter with RDKit; defaults to
                        current interpreter
